description: The page geometry and pagination that both PXA invoice renderers implement. The Designer projects an invoice onto Canvas and Live Preview pages; EInvoice.CreatePdf renders the dedicated hybrid PDF. Neither depends on the other, so this file is what keeps them putting the same content on the same pages. Measurements are PDF points from the top of an A4 page.

cases.description: Three short lines and one tax group stay on one page.
The largest line count that still fits on page one with its totals (19).
One line past capacity moves the totals to a second page.
Enough lines to need several continuation pages.
A layout with no tax breakdown still places the totals.
A single group is its own tax total, so no aggregate row is added.
Two groups plus the aggregate tax-total row.
Eight groups grow the totals block but still fit one page.
Eighty groups continue across several totals pages.
Eighty groups after a line table that already fills pages.
One description too long for any page, split into continuation fragments.
